production.cause: Solid unconditionally saved next.name as fallback even while Root supplied its own name. CheckboxGroup receives that effective name back, so removing fruits could never invalidate its name-gated registration.
production.fix: As source, Root-owned names suppress registration fallback. Refresh fallback from the current intrinsic control registration when raw Root name changes, preserving Field.Control email fallback after Root override removal. Previous controlled-name regression was caught by the complete focused run and corrected; no assertion weakened.
